name: Condemnation (General)
body:
Your craven evil is written on your face, as Gerana has seen every evil deed you have perpetrated!

Prerequisite(s): Detect evil class ability, Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You may use his Knowledge (religion) bonus in place of his Intimidate bonus to use intimidation on evil creatures.
